candidate_relations.reason: The histologic finding of perilobular/periductal chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils with no granulomata, normal peripheral eosinophils, exclusion of hypereosinophilic syndrome, and no identifiable systemic cause all support idiopathic eosinophilic mastitis. The 'idiopathic' qualifier is a harmless specificity addition consistent with the clinical record and does not conflict with the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Eosinophilic mastitis with idiopathic qualifier; same diagnostic entity
